Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: customer-service-reply
Version: 2.3.0

The skill bundle is a legitimate customer service template generator. The core logic in `scripts/cs.sh` is a self-contained Python script that generates text-based replies for various e-commerce scenarios (presale, complaints, refunds, etc.) based on user input. It does not perform any network requests, file system modifications, or sensitive data access, and it lacks any signs of obfuscation or malicious intent.

llm.guidance: This skill appears to be a local, self-contained customer-service reply generator and does not request credentials or perform network calls — that's a good sign. However: 1) The package origin is unknown (no homepage) — prefer packages from known sources. 2) The static scanner flagged invisible Unicode control characters in SKILL.md; review SKILL.md and scripts/cs.sh for any hidden or unexpected text (zero-width chars) before installing. 3) If you want extra safety, open and read scripts/cs.sh to confirm there's no networking or file-exfiltration, and run it first in an isolated/sandbox environment (or container) before use. 4) If you plan to deploy this in production, prefer getting the script from a trusted source or regenerating equivalent templates in-house.
llm.findings: [unicode-control-chars] unexpected: Scanner detected Unicode control / invisible characters in SKILL.md. This is not expected for a simple template generator. It may be benign (formatting, copy/paste artifacts) but can also be used for prompt-injection or to hide content. The rest of the code (scripts/cs.sh) is plain and has no network calls.
